why: Standard sources (ScienceDirect, arXiv survey papers, Wikipedia article) still describe the conjectures as open, with Peligrad's partial result under an added hypothesis being the main known progress. Search results also surfaced a 'vibemathed.com'/'vibemathing' GitHub site claiming an AI system ('GPT-6 Astra') produced a Lean counterexample in September 2026, but this appears to be a fabricated or gamified content source (self-described 'vibe mathing' project, no legitimate paper, journal, or arXiv posting corroborates it), so it is not treated as evidence of real progress.
